injectionMissedNote: injection_missed = program completed without mid-flight paused_for_kill. Counted in gates.injection; does not set ok=false under correctness_availability_v2 and is not a durability loss. ok=true with injectionClean=false means the board measured durability but the pause injector missed some windows. Historical journal-surrogate settles must carry basis=journal_surrogate + effect_ledger=unavailable — never read as verified.

evidenceOverwrite.note: Overwrite escape hatch was not set; unique path or first write.

effectLedgerPersistedNote: Per-trial mock-pets __writes + twin digest under evidenceTrialsDir/trials/. Independent of ProgramCell journal. Missing ledger fails the board (frozen). Precondition for v4 settle.

correctness.meaning: wrong outcome only — duplicates / midflight_effect_gt_one, journal_divergence, write rerun, digest_mismatch, lost_midflight_intent, midflight_not_outcome_unknown (in-flight trials must be outcome_unknown; at most one effect), stale_owner_send. injection_missed is NOT correctness. Phase targeting validity (during_call callVerifiedSent) is gates.phaseValidity, not correctness.

injection.meaning: pause window missed — program completed without mid-flight pause. Counted openly; not a pass and not a durability loss.

availability.meaning: no outcome in wall-clock time (recovery inclusive) — deadline miss, pause_failed, call_never_sent (during_call never reached mock pets inFlight), twin_capture_failed, await not survive/complete; failure-rate ceiling fixed before run; resumeMs/recoveryMs/resumeActiveMs tails reported without a pass/fail ceiling

outerCompletion.meaning: reported overall; each miss assigned to correctness or availability — not a separate zero-gate

missingData.meaning: Frozen before v4: (1) every trial must persist effect-ledger.json — missing counts against the board; (2) outer twin-eligible captured:false rate ≤ twinCaptureFailCeiling (mid-flight excluded); (3) any FLEET_PHASED_ALLOW_OVERWRITE use invalidates the artifact.

midFlightEffectDistribution.meaning: Effect counts from mock-pets ledger (writeCount). during_call.callVerifiedSent = sawInFlight before kill. Zero callVerifiedSent across all during_call trials ⇒ phase targeting invalid (injector never mid-call).

midFlightCorrectness.meaning: Mid-flight (after_intent_before_call, during_call): writeCount ≤ 1 (never 2+); every trial must be outcome_unknown. Violations are correctness failures (midflight_effect_gt_one / midflight_not_outcome_unknown).

phaseValidity.meaning: Frozen before v4: if the board includes during_call trials, at least one must have callVerifiedSent (mock inFlight before kill). Otherwise the phase is mislabeled — injection landed before the call — and the board cannot claim to have tested during-call crashes.

frozenCriteria.resumeDeadlineMeaning: wall clock including orchestrator recovery; same for write-kill and await

missingData.twinCaptureFailDenominator: outer phases (before_intent, after_call_before_journal) with completedClean; mid-flight captured:false excluded

frozenCriteria.note: Do not change these after the run starts. Tails (resumeMs/recoveryMs/resumeActiveMs p99/max) are reported without a ceiling. injection_missed is reported in gates.injection and does not loosen correctness or availability. Missing-data + phase-validity rules are hard gates for v4.

midFlightEffectDistribution.meaning: Effect counts from mock-pets ledger (writeCount). during_call.callVerifiedSent = sawInFlight before kill. Zero callVerifiedSent across all during_call trials ⇒ phase targeting invalid (injector never mid-call).

identityNote: Prefer celldLabGitCommit + celldSha256 over celldBuild/celldBinaryVersion. Soak↔v4 authorization requires the same commit (with expiry≠dead + BOOTTIME + enriched supersede) and ideally matching sha256.

resumeLatencyNote.meaning: CELLD_TTL_MS=3000 (not stock 10000). Resume p50≈7437ms is lease-dominated under this TTL; do not compare to stock ~12–14s boards.

callSent.meaning: sawInFlight = mock pets __writes.inFlight>0 before wedge/SIGKILL (egress after durable ack). neverSent = availability failure call_never_sent. Settled fenced arm requires sawInFlight===n and outcomeUnknown+intent visible on every trial.

completed.note: rateOuterPhases uses only before_intent + after_call_before_journal. Mid-flight phases (after_intent_before_call, during_call) are expected to end outcome_unknown — they are counted in n / rateAllPhases but not in the outer completion window. No trials are dropped.

statePreserved.note: Eligible = outer-phase trials that completedClean. Failures classify as twin_capture_failed (baseline twin never completed — often fleet SELF-FENCE) vs digest_mismatch (twin completed but digests differ). Both fail the rate; they are not the same cause. Mid-flight excluded by definition.

waitApproval.note: Separate arm (FLEET_PHASED_AWAIT_TRIALS), not a subset of write-kill N. Every await trial is in this denominator.

stepsRepeated.note: Sum of pets-ledger duplicates across all write-kill trials (target 0).

availability.meaning: availability — lease self-fence + orchestrator restart counted; recovery folded into resumeMs

completed.meaning: claim-path §1 — % of resumed programs that reached completed without outcome_unknown; outer phases (before_intent / after_call_before_journal) are the fair completion window; mid-flight phases expect unknown

stepsRepeated.meaning: claim-path §1 — completed write steps that ran again on the host (pets ledger duplicates); target 0. journal_divergence hard-stops when a stored entry no longer matches the plan (ProgramCellDO + Node durable-runner)

statePreserved.meaning: claim-path §1 — exact digest equality vs per-trial no-crash twin. Per-trial reason: digest_match | digest_mismatch | twin_capture_failed (twin never completed; not evidence the resume mutated state). Mid-flight excluded (see trialAccounting).

waitApproval.meaning: claim-path §4 — await_approval parks while pending, survives peer SIGKILL, then completes after approve (observe-only; never consumes). Separate arm from write-kill phases (see trialAccounting.waitApproval). okRate uses planned n; also report ran/ok/failed + failureByReason so incomplete or park-fail meltdowns are not ambiguous.

claim: Across 1000 crashes injected at every phase of a write, programs resumed on another node with no repeated writes (the 95% upper bound on the duplicate rate is 0.3%). The median resume took about 7 seconds, set by the lease timeout. Writes caught mid-flight are marked outcome unknown for a person to resolve. Under these settings, 2.4% of surviving nodes paused themselves for safety, and 0.1% of resumes missed the recovery deadline.
honesty: Two celld nodes, one object-storage provider (R2). Not durable execution / exactly-once. Columns: duplicates (safety), outcome_unknown (uncertainty), survivor self-fence/restart (availability), claim-path completed + stepsRepeated, plus statePreserved (exact digest equality vs per-trial no-crash twin on outer phases) and waitApproval (separate FLEET_PHASED_AWAIT_TRIALS arm). Denominators: see trialAccounting — no trials filtered; outer-only rates exclude mid-flight kills that intentionally end outcome_unknown. Completed reads are journaled and replayed; an interrupted read with no entry is re-requested once (resumption assumes that re-read is acceptable). Model calls: at most one repeated model request per crash, never a repeated write. Aggregate outcome_unknown ≈ half only because kills are aimed evenly at four phases — two are the in-flight window; outer phases must stay 0 (nonzero = bug). Resume p50 ≈ lease TTL + detection (failover floor).

lease.note: Renewals should complete with headroom ≫ R2 RTT. Stock CELLD_TTL_MS=10000 renews near ~6665ms headroom; slow renew cycles under peer-down storms can fence. See AVAILABILITY.md.
